english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_PriorHousebr: Chance of previous housebreaking independent of working history and breed.

english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_TrainingRate: Multiplier for eligible successful structured learning; elapsed days never unlock commands automatically.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_StructuredXP: Maximum normalized structured reward units across the preceding 24 game hours, per dog.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_PassiveXPBud: Maximum normalized passive reward units across the preceding 24 game hours, per dog; zero disables new passive awards.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_PassiveTrain: Multiplier for verified passive success; proximity and idle time alone never earn XP.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_CueTransferR: Learning multiplier for a new cue for an already learned behavior; discovery itself gives no XP.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_LeashHandlin: Scale proved dog/player handling difficulty; never enable unproved physical pulling or stumbling.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_CueSoundRadi: Scale audible cue attraction radius within verified API limits; silent cues never create sound.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_NativeHunger: Scale native intake/need rates only through a proved single-writer seam; otherwise this candidate setting is not exposed.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_FatigueRate_: Scale fatigue only through a proved native-owned rate seam; no second catch-up timer.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_StressSensit: Scale situational extension stress response without rerolling intrinsic confidence/anxiety.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_CareRecovery: Scale approved recovery with actual care/resources and game time; no instant healing.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_GroomingFreq: Scale coat-appropriate grooming needs using reviewed original care rules.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_IllnessSever: Scale severity of implemented reviewed conditions; unrelated diseases are not invented.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_InjurySeveri: Scale supported injury effects after native/extension regional attribution and writer proof.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_Rehabilitati: Scale gradual rehabilitation with time/resources; severe neglect remains an extended-care scenario.

english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_HomeCareAuto: Permit reachable home feeding/watering/rest with actual resources and permissions.

english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_EmergencyDoo: Permit server-authorized emergency lockdown only when physical transition/interruption behavior is proved.

english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_ZombieDoorIn: Scale plausible interaction frequency/effort, never body fit or physical collision eligibility.

english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_ScentDifficu: Choose reviewed discrimination/search difficulty; requires real target accessibility.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_Environmenta: Permit individually proved environment/occlusion effects, not fictional odor plumes.

english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_AudibleLures: Permit safe deliver-retreat/remote sound tasks; dogs need not remain beside activated lures.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_ToyLaunchers: Permit proved compatible thrown-object launcher and landing-item recovery.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_PackSizeLimi: Maximum managed members per pack; lowering blocks additions without deleting or unbinding dogs.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_PackSocialCo: Scale stress/resource-linked disputes; zero prevents new conflict events; serious fights remain uncommon.

english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_CaptureDiffi: Scale validated capture challenge and welfare response, not training bonuses from punishment.
english_fallback.Sandbox_B47ANCEDDogTraining_TransportStr: Scale known confinement/transport extension stress; same identity and game-time clock persist.
